name: Northline Pump & Valve
description: Northline Pump & Valve is a manufacturer's representative selling submersible and vertical turbine pumps, check and gate valves, SCADA control panels and packaged lift stations to municipal water, wastewater and stormwater agencies in the Cascadia region. We provide application engineering, startup and field service.

pastBids.title: Elm Street Lift Station Pump Replacement
pastBids.summary: Supplied two 30 HP submersible pumps, VFD panel and SCADA integration for a duplex lift station; commissioned on schedule.

pastBids.title: Ridgeway Booster Station Package
pastBids.summary: Packaged booster station with three vertical turbine pumps, AWWA C508 check valves and a UL 508A control panel.

pastBids.title: Delta Basin Stormwater Pump Station
pastBids.summary: Proposed four 60 HP stormwater pumps with level controls; lost on price to a competing packaged system.
